sources.title: ACF Awards Over $100 Million to Promote Healthy Marriage, Responsible Fatherhood, and Strong Families Across America

status_summary: On 2025-07-15 ACF's Office of Family Assistance posted a funding opportunity, READY4Life, with about $23.1 million for healthy marriage and relationship education for youth in grades 9 to 12 and ages 14 to 24, alongside an adult-focused HEART opportunity of about $34.65 million. On 2025-09-30 ACF announced over $100 million in Healthy Marriage and Responsible Fatherhood awards to 109 organizations in 38 states, including both programs. Neither the listing nor the announcement mentions sexual risk avoidance or high schools, and no change to CAPTA or Title IV-B law, no Title X requirement to give marriage information and no specific protection for grantees' definition of marriage was found.

timeline.event: ACF Office of Family Assistance posted the READY4Life funding opportunity (about $23.1 million, 26 expected awards) for healthy marriage and relationship education for youth in grades 9 to 12 and ages 14 to 24, closing 2025-07-29.
ACF Office of Family Assistance posted the HEART funding opportunity (about $34.65 million, 40 expected awards) for healthy marriage and relationship education for adults, closing 2025-07-29.

ACF announced over $100 million in Healthy Marriage and Responsible Fatherhood awards to 109 organizations in 38 states, including HEART (marriage and relationship education) and READY4Life (ages 14 to 24).

title: Use HMRE funds for high school marriage education; marriage information at Title X clinics
uncertainties: The READY4Life listing and the ACF award announcement of 2025-09-30 were read in full; the announcement refers to a new cohort of grantees but does not mention high schools, sexual risk avoidance or new priorities. The listing does not say whether it is new or a re-competition, and a youth-focused HMRE grant line appears to have existed before 2025, so the 2025 opportunity and awards may be routine; this was not verified. The awards fund local grantees rather than state-level curricula. A Federal Register API search for Healthy Marriage since 2025-01-20 returned four ACF documents (HMRF performance-measure information collections of 2026-01-29 and 2026-05-04, a Head Start proposed rule, a research information collection), none read for marriage content; a Federal Register API search for Title X with marriage since 2025-01-20, rerun in review on 2026-10-18, returned no documents. Congressional action on CAPTA or Title IV-B was not searched. Related teen pregnancy prevention redirection is tracked in c14-25.
